title: [Activity] Recommendations from 20 million ratings with Spark

cues.en: We promised we'd scale things up in this section, so let's see what Apache Spark can do, even on a single PC.
cues.zh: 我們說過，這一節要擴大處理規模，現在就來看看 Apache Spark 能做些什麼，即使只用一台個人電腦。

cues.en: We're going to straight from the 100,000 ratings dataset we've been using so far, to the 20 million ratings dataset from MovieLens!
cues.zh: 我們要從目前一直使用的十萬筆評分資料集，直接跳到 MovieLens 的兩千萬筆評分資料集！

cues.en: Let's see if Spark can handle that.
cues.zh: 看看 Spark 能不能處理。

cues.en: MovieLens's license terms don't allow me to redistribute their data, so you'll have to head over to grouplens.org, select the Datasets page, and download the ml-20m.zip file
cues.zh: MovieLens 的授權條款不允許我重新散布資料，所以你得前往 grouplens.org，選取 Datasets 頁面，下載 ml-20m.zip 檔案，

cues.en: from the 20 million ratings dataset there.
cues.zh: 也就是那裡的兩千萬筆評分資料集。

cues.en: Once it's downloaded, decompress it,
cues.zh: 下載完成後，將它解壓縮，

cues.en: and place the ml-20m folder inside your course materials folder.
cues.zh: 再把 ml-20m 資料夾放進課程教材資料夾。

cues.en: Now, let's go back to Spyder, and open up the SparkALS-20m.py file.
cues.zh: 現在回到 Spyder，開啟 SparkALS-20m.py 檔案。

cues.en: There are only a couple of things we changed here.
cues.zh: 這裡只改了幾個地方。

cues.en: First, I wrote a new loadMovieNames function instead of relying on our MovieLens module, because the movie IDs in the 20 million dataset are different from the ones in the 100 K data set.
cues.zh: 首先，我寫了一個新的 loadMovieNames 函式，沒有沿用 MovieLens 模組，因為兩千萬筆資料集的電影 ID，與十萬筆資料集中的不同。

cues.en: This is really just copied and pasted from the code in our MovieLens module that did the same thing for the 100 K dataset, just using a different file path.
cues.zh: 這其實只是把 MovieLens 模組中，針對十萬筆資料集執行相同工作的程式碼複製貼上，再換個檔案路徑。

cues.en: The only other change is on line 31, you can see here that I've added a configuration setting to our SparkSession specifying that it should use four CPU cores.
cues.zh: 唯一另一個修改在第 31 行。可以看到，我在 SparkSession 加了一個設定，指定使用四個 CPU 核心。

cues.en: My PC has four cores, so I can tell Spark to use them all and it's sort of like having a cluster of four machines at that point.
cues.zh: 我的電腦有四個核心，所以可以要求 Spark 全部使用，這時就有點像擁有四台機器的叢集。

cues.en: Technically, four executor processes will be spun up on my PC when I run this, all running in parallel on different parts of the data.
cues.zh: 就技術上而言，執行時會在我的電腦啟動四個執行器程序，同時平行處理資料的不同部分。

cues.en: Without that parallelism, 20 million ratings would be too much for a single process to handle.
cues.zh: 如果沒有這種平行處理，單一程序就無法負荷兩千萬筆評分。

cues.en: If your PC has a different number of CPU cores, you'll want to change this value accordingly.
cues.zh: 如果你的電腦 CPU 核心數不同，就要相應修改這個值。

cues.en: When you're running on a real cluster though, things are usually pre-configured such that the default settings Spark uses are already optimized to the hardware available on your cluster.
cues.zh: 但在真正的叢集上執行時，通常都已預先設定好，Spark 的預設設定就已針對叢集可用的硬體最佳化。

cues.en: You don't normally need to think about this, or hard-code assumptions about your hardware into the script, this is just a special case because we're running on a single PC and not on a real cluster.
cues.zh: 通常不用考慮這件事，也不必在程式裡寫死硬體假設。這裡只是特例，因為我們是在一台個人電腦上執行，而非真正的叢集。

cues.en: In the real world, you'll usually be working on a cluster of some sort, and what I said earlier about using the same exact driver code no matter how big your cluster is would be true.
cues.zh: 實務上通常會使用某種叢集，而我先前說的，不論叢集多大都能使用完全相同的驅動程式碼，也確實成立。

cues.en: Let's kick it off.
cues.zh: 開始執行吧。

cues.en: It will of course take some time to train a matrix factorization model with 20 million ratings, and then generate top 10 recommendations for every single user in that dataset
cues.zh: 用兩千萬筆評分訓練矩陣分解模型，再為資料集中的每一位使用者產生前十名推薦，當然需要一些時間，

cues.en: but it actually finishes more quickly than some scripts we've run with just 100,000 ratings!
cues.zh: 但它完成得比我們某些只處理十萬筆評分的程式還快！

cues.en: We'll pause, and come back when it's done.
cues.zh: 先暫停一下，完成後再回來。

cues.en: Okay, by the way, if you got an error after running this script but the previous one worked for you, try just closing out the console window and getting a fresh one and trying again.
cues.zh: 好了，順帶一提，如果前一個程式能執行，但執行這個程式時卻發生錯誤，可以試著關閉主控台視窗，開一個新的，再試一次。

cues.en: So, you might recall that with the 100,000 ratings dataset, our RMSE was 1.12, which wasn't great
cues.zh: 你可能記得，使用十萬筆評分資料集時，RMSE 是 1.12，表現並不好，

cues.en: but now it's down to 0.81, which is actually pretty awesome.
cues.zh: 但現在降到 0.81，這其實相當出色。

cues.en: This tells us that the ALS algorithm in Spark's ML library doesn't work well with small datasets, or it's tuned for larger ones with its default hyperparameters, or both.
cues.zh: 這告訴我們，Spark ML 程式庫中的 ALS 演算法不適合小型資料集，或者它的預設超參數是針對大型資料集調整的，也可能兩者都是。

cues.en: But regardless of the reason, these results are much better at least in terms of accuracy.
cues.zh: 無論原因是什麼，至少就準確度而言，這些結果好多了。

cues.en: We will also sample the recommendations of a given user, but you have to keep in mind user 85 in this dataset isn't the same user 85 that was in our 100 K dataset.
cues.zh: 我們也會抽樣查看某位使用者的推薦，但要記住，這個資料集中的使用者 85，和十萬筆資料集中的使用者 85 並不是同一個人。

cues.en: Also, the results you see on your PC will be different because there is a random component to how the model is trained.
cues.zh: 另外，模型訓練含有隨機成分，所以你在自己電腦上看到的結果會不同。

cues.en: But, after running it a couple of times, it would seem that this user's tastes are pretty obscure, but somewhat consistent.
cues.zh: 不過，執行幾次後，看起來這位使用者的品味頗為冷門，但還算一致。

cues.en: Old movies from the 30s and 40s keep coming up for him or her, as well as more modern, foreign films or films about foreign lands.
cues.zh: 推薦中不斷出現三○、四○年代的老電影，也有較現代的外國電影，或以外國為背景的電影。

cues.en: Even if we don't have a deep subjective understanding of this user and the movies being recommended, we can still see that there seem to be some coherent patterns in what's being recommended that aren't just random,
cues.zh: 即使我們對這位使用者和推薦的電影沒有深入的主觀了解，仍能看出推薦內容似乎有一些連貫的模式，而不是完全隨機，

cues.en: so that's a good sign that this system is doing something useful.
cues.zh: 這是個好現象，代表系統確實在做有用的事。

cues.en: But, the really impressive thing is that we just built a really good recommender system in just a few minutes from 20 million ratings!
cues.zh: 但真正令人印象深刻的是，我們只花幾分鐘，就用兩千萬筆評分建立了一個很好的推薦系統！

cues.en: That is truly big data, and thanks to the efficiency of Spark, we didn't even need more than one computer to do it!
cues.zh: 這確實是巨量資料，而憑藉 Spark 的效率，只用一台電腦就能完成！

cues.en: Apache Spark is pretty cool, and it's worth learning about in more depth.
cues.zh: Apache Spark 很厲害，值得更深入學習。

cues.en: But it is a bit limited in the tools it offers for producing recommendations, let's look at some other systems that can produce recommendations at massive scale.
cues.zh: 不過，它用來產生推薦的工具還是有些限制。接著看看其他能大規模產生推薦的系統。
